title: Material plant-performance claims versus a complete energy-conversion balance
initial_observation: IF a material financing, subsidy or operating-performance claim states or demonstrably relies on the exact output, input or efficiency quantities being tested for an identified fuel-fired plant and interval, and comparable official records are available for its complete physical boundary. EIA values are operator-reported measurements or estimates, not independent observations.
expected_observation: THEN test whether even a conservative lower bound on electrical energy produced exceeds a conservative upper bound on all energy inputs, after resolving revisions and boundary flows. An unresolved excess identifies incompatible evidence requiring correction or explanation, not automatically fraud. If the claim does not state or rely on the tested quantities, classify the result only as an EIA reporting-quality lead, not a contradiction of that claim.
basis: Energy conservation supplies a physical bound, unlike a discretionary industry-efficiency benchmark. Net generation converted to energy cannot exceed all consumed inputs over a closed, reconciled system interval. Finite storage changes and every external energy contribution must be bounded. A ratio below the bound says nothing about honest reporting or economic efficiency.
operational_join: Issuer CIK/accession and exact plant passage → documented facility/operator/location crosswalk → EIA plant code, year/month, prime mover and fuel/source rows. Aggregate each physical input/output once; reconcile combined-cycle combustion and steam equipment so recovered internal heat is not new external input. A company name or regional series is not a plant match.
temporal_geographic_scope: US EIA-covered plants with fuel-only generation and a verified boundary. Begin with a simple non-CHP plant; defer CHP, hybrid solar/wind, pumped/battery storage, nuclear, imported steam or waste heat unless every contribution and allocation is independently reconciled. Use consumed fuel, not purchases; use full total fuel input, not only fuel statistically allocated to electricity. Same period and corrected filing vintage.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Missing fuel/source or unit", "Fuel purchases confused with consumption", "Electricity receipts or sales confused with generation", "Heat-content basis or unit conversion mismatch", "Gross/net/direct-use differences", "Rounding or uncertainty explains excess", "Thermal or electrical stored-energy release", "Internal recovered steam double-counted", "Plant/prime-mover boundary mismatch", "Revised or estimated data", "Claim refers to contractual attributes rather than physical performance"]
mandatory_evidence: ["Original material claim and its exact metric", "Plant identity crosswalk", "Complete generation and all energy-input records for matching boundary/period", "Data definitions, heat-content basis and revision history", "Evidence excluding or measuring imported energy and storage changes", "Conservative output/input bounds and tolerance"]
next_cheapest_check: Read the claim and plant technology first; reject an economic or certificate claim that makes no physical assertion. Inspect one plant-period schema and all source codes before calculating. Stop if complete input or boundary evidence is unavailable.
novelty_comparison: R13 and C01 compare emissions with activity; N09 uses national production as an external upper bound. B01 is a complete physical conversion-balance test with materially different input evidence. One proposed formulation; different fuels, months and plants are implementations, not new tests.
access_evidence: Current EIA form instructions and public data documentation inspected. Field meanings and bulk publication are confirmed; no plant rows or issuer-to-plant crosswalk were acquired. Current instructions separate consumption, generation and incoming electricity. No end-to-end feasibility established.

title: The same eligible cost reimbursed beyond its permitted funding
initial_observation: IF operative financing instruments permit reimbursement only up to a specified eligible cost/share, and original evidence attributes two or more independent completed reimbursements to the same uniquely identified cost item.
expected_observation: THEN reconstruct each payment path, permitted sharing, credits and reversals and compare the conservative lower bound of distinct net reimbursements with the conservative upper bound of the combined permitted recovery, which can be less than invoice cost. Check each funder’s individual cap separately; satisfying a combined cap does not establish each individual cap was met. Retain an unresolved excess for source-document review.
basis: This is an instrument-specific cost-recovery constraint. Two project commitments or two descriptions of one transfer are not two recoveries. A payable supplier invoice can legitimately be financed through several parties, and authorized cofinancing can split its cost. No universal prohibition across all grant or results-based funding is asserted.
operational_join: World Bank project ID → exact loan/credit ID and original financing/disbursement documents → expenditure schedule/audit and uniquely identified invoice/cost item (issuer, invoice number/date, line, amount/currency) → actual settled payment references and payer/payee chain. OCDS transaction source/URI and IATI activity/transaction references can trace mirrored or onward flows, but neither necessarily publishes invoice-level identity. A shared project ID is only discovery.
temporal_geographic_scope: Exact instrument, category, funded share, eligible-cost period and accounting/currency basis. Exclude results-based or unrestricted funding unless its own terms impose this cost cap. Resolve advance liquidation, prefinancing reimbursement, retention, tax, exchange rates, partial credit notes and corrections. Use historical records current to each payment.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Same transfer mirrored by donor and recipient", "Pass-through financing counted at each stage", "Advance later liquidated rather than new money", "Permitted cofinancing within cost/share", "Invoice number reused by different vendors or years", "Credit note/refund", "Different cost lines or phases", "Commitment mistaken for payment", "Currency or tax basis differs", "Results-based payment not cost reimbursement", "Revised schedule republishes old expenditure"]
mandatory_evidence: ["Each funder’s individual cap and the separately established combined permitted-recovery cap; invoice face amount alone is not either cap", "Original eligible cost and adjustments", "Evidence linking each claimed recovery to exactly that cost", "Independent settlement records or an authoritative audit establishing payment", "Full transfer-chain and correction/refund evidence", "Conservative compatible-currency bounds"]
next_cheapest_check: Open a public project audit or expenditure schedule and establish whether it names the same cost and actual financing sources. If only project-level totals are published, defer before summing anything. No requests or full investigations are initiated.
novelty_comparison: N01 is aid-report reconciliation, X02 payment-obligation reconciliation and Z01 bid-rate arithmetic. This tests multiple independent recoveries against one constrained underlying cost. It is one proposed new formulation, not one per funding pair. When the funding terms do not constrain cost recovery, reject.
access_evidence: World Bank disbursement guidance confirms several payment methods and supporting-document types; OCDS and IATI definitions supply possible flow links. Public availability of the needed original invoices, settlements and complete financing chain has not been established. Zero matched projects or cost items.

title: A file-specific no-conflict declaration versus a verified private interest
initial_observation: IF a member expressly declares no conflict for a specific parliamentary file and dated evidence establishes an actual private financial or organizational interest affected by that precise matter.
expected_observation: THEN reconcile the exact member, file, declared scope, interest type and dates, plus any disclosure, authorization or resolution, before describing an unresolved inconsistency in the statement.
basis: A hidden relevant private interest can affect public trust in a legislative decision. A broad sector interest, a disclosed role, or a register contact name alone does not establish a prohibited conflict. Permission to act despite a disclosed conflict is distinct from a false no-conflict statement.
operational_join: EP member ID and procedure/document ID → original signed file-specific declaration and actual role → dated company registration/role/ownership evidence. EU Transparency Register ID links an organization or client, not an individual beneficial owner. Resolve the person beyond name and distinguish employer, director, shareholder and contact roles.
temporal_geographic_scope: Specific file and declaration/appointment interval. Use operative rules at that date; older codes differ. Not every private interest is a conflict and public asset declarations are not assumed available. No automatic recusal requirement is asserted.
ordinary_explanations_and_disqualifiers: ["Namesake", "Role or ownership ended earlier", "Only broad-class interest", "Interest already within declared scope", "No affirmative no-conflict assertion", "Disclosed conflict with permitted participation", "Register contact not beneficial owner", "Different legal entity or legislative file"]
mandatory_evidence: ["Exact original declaration and file", "Member identity and role dates", "Verified private interest and economic relevance to the file", "Applicable dated definition and declaration scope", "Other disclosures, amendments and any permission/resolution"]
next_cheapest_check: Find the original file-specific statement before searching company names. If it is absent, do not infer a denial. Establish one documented member-to-entity bridge before broad ownership exploration.
novelty_comparison: Refinement of H04 conflict disclosure and REF-REL explicit relationship flags. This provides an additional legislative implementation route without adding to the non-refinement total.
access_evidence: Official search-index text, including a dated 2024 rules excerpt, identifies declaration routes and limits. Both current and dated PDF opens returned unusable HTML pages. No actual member, declaration, company interest or case-specific rule matched; access failure preserved.
